question: what are the requirements set out in Section 2?
history: What must providers of high-risk AI systems do?

Providers of high-risk AI systems must ensure that their systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Section 2 (Article 16, point (a)), and must, upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the system with those requirements (Article 16, point (k)).
